name: A.txt and a.txt from a case-sensitive system reach a disk that ignores case: one comes down, the other is listed, both stay on the drive
description: KOOFR-010 (Koofr's case-insensitive namespace): 'Hello.doc' and 'hello.doc' could not coexist; one upload failed or overwrote the other. Rules P1 and P5: case is kept; on a disk that ignores case the file already here (else the one committed first) comes down and the other is listed (name-collision) and stays on the drive; nothing is overwritten. sync-chaos port-case-collision-remote.
